answer: Two scales stand in the mill yard, and no sack leaves until both agree. Proof of tanner hide via bark pit tally is the agreement: a hide the tanner lifts only after 30 days in the bark pit, the tally kept by two men who never count alone. The atlas is the first scale, kept honest by the miller's own weights; the signal is the second, kept honest by the town's. A cheat must rig 53 false weighings on both scales in one morning, and the trellis still disagrees by a full stone.
